title: Weeknight Focaccia
description: A same-day focaccia with rosemary and flaky salt, mixed and baked in an evening instead of proofing overnight.

items.note: for the pan and the dimples

steps.text: Mix the flour, water, yeast, fine salt, and 3 tablespoons of olive oil in a bowl until you have a shaggy, sticky dough. Cover and let it rise in a warm spot until doubled, about 45 minutes to an hour.
Oil a 9x13 pan with most of the ½ cup of olive oil. Turn the dough into the pan and stretch it toward the corners. If it springs back, wait 10 minutes and stretch again.
Dimple the surface with wet fingers, drizzle over the remaining oil, and sprinkle with the rosemary and flaky salt.
Bake at 425°F / 220°C until deep golden, 20–25 minutes.
Cool 10 minutes in the pan, then lift out and tear.

notes: Leftovers make great sandwiches the next day.
